borders.reason: Sixteen unique organic alpha overlays are authored transition decorations. They are not a verified automatic 16-state bitmask/Wang set; requested orientations vary from actual generated silhouettes. Ground adjacency pixel seams and renderer integration remain unverified.
borders.renderGuidance: Use provided actual alpha silhouettes. Deterministic family blending, gap-free underlay, and placement contract must be supplied by integration.

wallNotes: Eight distinct wall/bank structures. WALL-02 and WALL-06 are original supplementary imagegen replacements with opposite diagonal orientation to WALL-01 and WALL-05 respectively. Discarded original members are preserved but not counted. No mirrored or recolored copies counted.

alpha.note: Generated genuine alpha retained through crop/resampling/packing. RGB beneath transparent pixels is not visible content. No chroma keying, alpha masks, or procedural repainting applied.

pendingAcceptance: Wall orientation and foot-anchor integration QA
